title: Computational Phase Transition Analysis
analysis_basis: Source analysis of trainer.py + existing A100 profiling data

phases.description: Iterations 0-2000, early Gaussian growth from 112K to 270K
phases.characteristics: Low N, low tile intersections, high gradient norms. SH degree=0 (only DC). Densification active every 100 iters. Opacity reset every 3000 (not yet triggered).
phases.dominant_kernel: intersect_sort still dominant but total forward <10ms
phases.what_changes_next: N grows, tile intersections increase, SH degree progresses, opacity resets begin

phases.characteristics: High N growth rate. SH degree=1-2. Opacity resets every 3000 cause transient N drops. Max tile intersections at ~77M (room, tile16). Forward=~4.8ms dominated by intersect_sort.
phases.dominant_kernel: intersect_sort (64-96% of forward time across all scenes)
phases.what_changes_next: N stabilizes, densification ends at 15000, gradient norms drop

phases.characteristics: Peak N. SH degree=3 (max). Opacity reset at 12000 and 15000 cause temporary N drops. Densification stops at iter 14999.
phases.dominant_kernel: intersect_sort still dominant, raster backward growing with N
phases.what_changes_next: Densification stops, no more clone/split/prune events

phases.characteristics: N frozen at 952K. No topology changes. SH degree=3. Gradient norms decrease by 30-50% vs densification phase. Loss still decreasing (PSNR climbs from 30.88 to 32.30).
what_work_changes: means2d.absgrad still computed but never read
max_radii2D still updated but only read for pruning (which never triggers)
what_work_unchanged: Full raster fwd/bwd unchanged (except absgrad atomicAdd)

phases.characteristics: Much higher tile intersections (600M+ for bicycle tile16) due to large screen coverage. Intersect_sort dominates even more (96-99% of forward time). Peak VRAM 21-23GB for outdoor tile16.
phases.note: Profiling data available for bicycle and garden at 10K with ~2.6M and 870K Gaussians respectively.

key_transitions.impact: Minor. SH forward kernel has fixed compute per degree. Higher degree means more CDIM values processed, but the incremental cost of going from deg0 (CDIM=1) to deg3 (CDIM=48) is <0.1ms total for forward.
key_transitions.kernels_executed_unchanged: All kernels still launch at every iteration regardless of SH degree. The _shs tensor always stores all 48 coefficients.

key_transitions.impact: MAJOR. add_densification_stats() stops, clone/split/prune stop, opacity reset stops. All backward kernels still execute unchanged. The absgrad path in raster backward continues executing (wasted).
key_transitions.kernels_executed_unchanged: rasterize_to_pixels_bwd (absgrad branch still active, just memory that is never read), fully_fused_projection_bwd, compute_sh_bwd

key_transitions.impact: Transient. Causes temporary N drop (pruning), then growth catches up within 100-200 iterations. Timing impact is minimal because topology ops are cheap relative to rendering.

conclusion: The dominant computational phase transition is densification_end (iter 15000). Before: N grows, topology changes, absgrad is consumed. After: N is fixed, topology is frozen, absgrad is dead work, but all other computation proceeds identically. SH degree progression has negligible effect on per-iteration time.
